_meta.com.requstory/summary: Start a made-up B2B store's month run by four order-to-cash agents.

description: Start a month of a made-up B2B online store (Harbour & Home) run by four AI agents: process orders, ship orders, invoice and collect payments, handle returns. Real trade order lines; you or your user play the founder, who is asked about credit limits, short stock, packing, reminders, unclear payments and returns. Sums, dates, stock and credit are worked out by code, not the model. No key needed; runs are deleted 2 days after the last change. Then call advance_o2c_run.

model.description: Open model the agents use. Default: the best scorer in the weekly test.

name: start_o2c_demo
title: Start an order-to-cash demo
